note: Whether Anthropic Admin Usage API records (claude_api) represent traffic already counted by the transcript extractors (claude_code, claude_cowork).

modes.unset: No decision recorded. A Claude API extractor writes to scratch/reconcile/ and the importer never sees those receipts. Run npm run reconcile:claude.
modes.additive: API usage is separate traffic. Receipts are written to scratch/receipts/ and imported as the claude_api source.
modes.overlapping: API usage duplicates transcript-derived requests. Receipts stay quarantined in scratch/reconcile/ and are excluded from totals; use them as a reconciliation oracle only.
